# Builder Facts: Volume Builders (Clark County, Nevada)

**Researcher:** Builder Facts Researcher, Volume Builders
**Verification date:** 2026-07-25
**Scope:** Clark County, Nevada only. Pahrump, Mesquite, and Boulder City rows were stripped and logged at the bottom of this file.
**Citation format:** `value [source: URL | verified: 2026-07-25]`
**Anything that could not be verified from a live source reads the literal string `NOT FOUND`.**

## How to read this file

Every fact below came from a live page load on 2026-07-25. Where a builder's own site does not publish a fact, the field says `NOT FOUND`. It does not say what the fact "usually" is. Several builders that the industry assumes use a 1-2-10 warranty do not publish term lengths at all, and that is recorded honestly.

Prices are the builder's own "from" or "starting at" figure on 2026-07-25. Those figures move weekly and almost never include lot premiums, options, or upgrades. Community counts are the builder's own count on the same date.

Two builders are the most likely to surprise a reader: **Beazer Homes has no in-house lender at all**, and **Meritage Homes does not currently build in Nevada**. Both are documented below.

---

## 1. Lennar

- **builder:** Lennar Corporation. Nevada building entities named in Lennar's own Las Vegas offer disclosure are Greystone Nevada, LLC (license 48844) and Ryland Homes Nevada, LLC (license 56652) [source: https://www.lennar.com/new-homes/nevada/las-vegas/promo/nevlen_oydq326 | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **warranty:** Lennar publishes the structure in a disclosure footnote, not on a warranty page. Verbatim: "Lennar Limited Warranty ("Limited Warranty") consists of: (a) a limited 1-year warranty on workmanship, (b) a limited 2-year warranty on systems, and (c) a limited 10-year warranty on structural elements. Exclusions apply. Proper maintenance of your Home is vital; failure to perform regular required maintenance can limit your Limited Warranty rights. Claims must be submitted as soon as possible and in no event later than the expiration date of the applicable limited warranty." [source: https://resourcecenter.lennar.com/homebuying/signing-the-purchase-agreement | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Same page, on variability: "The length and scope of the Limited Warranty will vary based on location and the type of home you are purchasing." [source: https://resourcecenter.lennar.com/homebuying/signing-the-purchase-agreement | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Note for the guide: `https://www.lennar.com/warranty` returns a "This page took a wrong turn" 404, and Lennar's own FAQ page answers warranty questions only by telling homeowners to call the local Customer Care team. It never states term lengths. [source: https://www.lennar.com/faqs | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **in_house_lender:** Lennar Mortgage, LLC, NMLS #1058. Nevada Mortgage Company License #1055, 6385 S. Rainbow Blvd. #300, Las Vegas, NV 89118, 702-868-3952 [source: https://www.lennar.com/new-homes/nevada/las-vegas/promo/nevlen_oydq326 | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - **Are incentives conditioned on using it? Yes.** Verbatim conditioning language: "Offer requires financing through seller's affiliate Lennar Mortgage, LLC, but use of Lennar Mortgage, LLC is not required to purchase a home (See Affiliated Business Arrangement Disclosure)." [source: https://www.lennar.com/new-homes/nevada/las-vegas/promo/nevlen_oydq326 | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Also verbatim: "Offers require financing through Lennar Mortgage, LLC" [source: https://www.lennar.com/new-homes/nevada/las-vegas/promo/nevlen_oydq326 | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Live Las Vegas offer on the verification date, quoted so the guide can date it correctly: a 7/6 adjustable rate mortgage fixed at 3.99% (6.496% APR) for the first seven years, on contracts signed 07/20/26 through 07/26/26 that close and fully fund by 08/28/26, on a $555,672 home price, requiring "a minimum of 20% down, a minimum credit score of 740", plus "a credit in an amount not to exceed $10,000 as determined on your Loan Estimate, excluding prepaids" and "Credit funds cannot be used to further buydown the rate." [source: https://www.lennar.com/new-homes/nevada/las-vegas/promo/nevlen_oydq326 | verified: 2026-07-25] **This offer expires 07/26/26. Do not print it in a guide as current.**

- **upgrade_policy:** Everything's Included. Lennar does not run a buyer-facing design center for its standard product. Verbatim: "Lennar has reimagined the homebuying experience by including the most desired home features at no extra cost to you. All features and products can vary by community and homesite." [source: https://www.lennar.com/everythings-included | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Lennar's own FAQ declines to publish any customization policy. To "Can I customize my home or get additional upgrades?" the answer is "To learn more about customizations and additional upgrades, contact a consultant for your community of interest." To "Can I make changes to Lennar floorplans?" the answer is "Available changes to Lennar floorplans vary by community." [source: https://www.lennar.com/faqs | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Published design-center spend requirement or design credit: NOT FOUND
  - Whether upgrades can be financed: NOT FOUND

- **build_timeline:** NOT FOUND. Lennar publishes no contract-to-close build time on its Las Vegas pages, its FAQ, or its Resource Center purchase-agreement article. That article does say the closing date matters: "The closing date provided in your Purchase Agreement is only an estimate." [source: https://resourcecenter.lennar.com/homebuying/signing-the-purchase-agreement | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Lennar does sell finished inventory. Its Las Vegas market page listed 107 available homes, the large majority tagged "Move-in ready" [source: https://www.lennar.com/new-homes/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **price_band:** Community starting prices across the Las Vegas market ran from $300K (The Richardson, Las Vegas) to $1.09M (The Estates, Las Vegas). Product is single family, townhomes, and Next Gen "home within a home" plans [source: https://www.lennar.com/new-homes/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Listed move-in-ready inventory on the same date ran from $298,500 (Heritage Square, North Las Vegas, 1,014 sq ft) to $2,068,600 (Summerlin, 3,894 sq ft) [source: https://www.lennar.com/new-homes/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]

## 2. D.R. Horton

- **builder:** D.R. Horton, Inc. [source: https://www.drhorton.com/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **warranty:** D.R. Horton uses a third-party administered 10 Year Written Warranty. Administrator is Residential Warranty Company, LLC (RWC). Insurer is Western Pacific Mutual Insurance Company, A Risk Retention Group. The document D.R. Horton links from its own site is marked WPMIC #319 Rev. 7/25 [source: https://www.drhorton.com/-/media/Files/warranty/Warranty%20Book%20-%20MSD%20-%20Full%20Coverage%20-%20319-725 | verified: 2026-07-25], reached from [source: https://www.drhorton.com/documents-and-guides | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - One year, verbatim: "ONE YEAR COVERAGE: Your Builder warrants that for a period of one (1) year after the Effective Date Of Warranty, warranted items will function and operate as presented in the Warranty Standards of Year 1, Section III.A."
  - Two years, verbatim: "TWO YEAR COVERAGE: Your Builder warrants that for a period of two (2) years from the Effective Date Of Warranty, specified portions of the Heating, Cooling, Ventilating, Electrical and Plumbing Systems, as defined in this Limited Warranty, will function and operate as presented in the Warranty Standards of Years 1 and 2 only, Section III.B."
  - Ten years, verbatim: "TEN YEAR COVERAGE: Major Structural Defects (MSD) are warranted for ten (10) years from the Effective Date Of Warranty."
  - **Who actually pays, verbatim:** "Your Builder is the Warrantor during Years 1 and 2 of this Limited Warranty and the Insurer is the Warrantor in Years 3 through 10." This is a real difference from builders who self-warrant all ten years.
  - Transfer, verbatim: "This Limited Warranty is automatically transferred to subsequent Owners during the ten-year term of this Limited Warranty, except in the case of a foreclosure that voids the warranty."
  - Appliances, verbatim: "Appliances and Equipment included in the Home are not warranted under this Limited Warranty, but may be covered by separate warranties provided by the manufacturer or supplier."
  - Dispute resolution, verbatim: the book "provides specific details, conditions and limitations of the Limited Warranty including procedures for requesting warranty performance and for binding arbitration, in accordance with the procedures of the Federal Arbitration Act."
  - All quotes above [source: https://www.drhorton.com/-/media/Files/warranty/Warranty%20Book%20-%20MSD%20-%20Full%20Coverage%20-%20319-725 | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **in_house_lender:** DHI Mortgage Company, Ltd. (DHIM). Company NMLS #14622. Las Vegas area branch NMLS #143413, 1081 Whitney Ranch Dr., Suite 100, Henderson, NV 89014, 702-635-3606. Verbatim: "DHIM is an affiliate of D.R. Horton." [source: https://www.drhorton.com/nevada/las-vegas/las-vegas/cambria-bay | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - **Are incentives conditioned on using it? Yes, for the advertised rate.** Verbatim: "Buyer is not required to finance through DHIM to purchase a home; however, buyer must use DHIM to receive the advertised rate." [source: https://www.drhorton.com/nevada/las-vegas/las-vegas/cambria-bay | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Also verbatim on how the rate is funded: "D.R. Horton has locked-in, through DHIM, a fixed interest rate for a pool of funds. Rates only available until pool of funds is depleted or rate expires." [source: https://www.drhorton.com/nevada/las-vegas/las-vegas/cambria-bay | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Rates advertised on the verification date: 5/1 FHA ARM at 3.875% (5.929% APR) and 5/1 VA ARM at 3.875% (5.538% APR) [source: https://www.drhorton.com/nevada/las-vegas/las-vegas/cambria-bay | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **upgrade_policy:** NOT FOUND. D.R. Horton publishes no design center, options catalog, or upgrade policy on its Las Vegas pages. Its Las Vegas communities carry the Express Series label and are marketed on included features, for example "Our kitchens are equipped with high-quality stainless-steel appliances, including a refrigerator, range, dishwasher, and microwave" and "Our homes include smart home technology" [source: https://www.drhorton.com/nevada/las-vegas/las-vegas/cambria-bay | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Published design-center spend requirement or credit: NOT FOUND
  - Whether upgrades can be financed: NOT FOUND

- **build_timeline:** NOT FOUND. D.R. Horton publishes no contract-to-close time for Las Vegas.
  - It does sell finished and near-finished inventory. Its Las Vegas market page counted 38 homes for sale across its communities on the verification date [source: https://www.drhorton.com/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Self-guided touring is offered at some communities: "This community offers self-guided tours through NterNow on select days/times" [source: https://www.drhorton.com/nevada/las-vegas/las-vegas/cambria-bay | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **price_band:** Actively selling community starting prices ran from $309,990 (Alpine Trails, Las Vegas 89107) to $764,990 (Heartland Summit Phase IV 4-Car at Tule Springs, North Las Vegas 89084). Product is single family, two-story dominant, 2 and 3 car garages [source: https://www.drhorton.com/api/comms/direct/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Pricing date: 2026-07-25.

- **clark_county_communities:** 22 communities, all in Clark County. Statuses are D.R. Horton's own labels on the verification date [source: https://www.drhorton.com/api/comms/direct/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]

## 3. Pulte Homes (PulteGroup)

- **builder:** Pulte Home Company, LLC. Verbatim from Pulte's own Las Vegas page footer: "Pulte Home Company, LLC is a licensed Nevada real estate broker (lic. # B.0145561) 7255 S Tenaya Way, Suite 200, Las Vegas, NV 89113 (702) 914-4800, NMLS Entity Identifier #1007381-240" [source: https://www.pulte.com/homes/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Scope note: this record covers the Pulte brand only. PulteGroup's other brands (Del Webb, American West, Centex, DiVosta, John Wieland) maintain separate community lists and are not included here.

- **warranty:** Pulte publishes the full National Transferable New Home Limited Warranty book, dated 08/19/24 and applicable to purchase agreements signed on or after September 1, 2024. Agreements signed before that date fall under a prior warranty, which Pulte links separately [source: https://www.pulte.com/build/10-year-warranty | verified: 2026-07-25]. Four tiers, all verbatim from the warranty book [source: https://res.cloudinary.com/dv0jqjrc3/image/upload/v1725037452/Creative%20Content_CCC/Warranty%20documents/2024%20Warranties/Pulte_National_Warranty_Book_081924F.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]:
  - One year: "materials and workmanship are warranted for one year from the time of closing."
  - Two years: "Two-year Coverage. The Builder warrants the workability of the plumbing, electrical, heating, ventilating, air conditioning, and other mechanical systems, as set forth in the Performance Standards, for a period of two years after the closing date."
  - **Five years, which most competitors do not offer:** "Five-year Coverage. The Builder warrants against certain types of water infiltration and internal leaks, as set forth in the Performance Standards, for a period of five years after the closing date."
  - Ten years: "Ten-year Coverage. The Builder warrants the construction of the home will conform to the tolerances set forth in the Performance Standards for Structural Elements for a period of ten years after the closing date." Structural Elements are defined as "load-bearing walls, beams, girders, trusses, rafters, bearing columns, lintels, posts, structural fasteners, subfloors, footings and roof sheathing. Floating slabs and partition walls that do not carry any load other than their own weight are not Structural Elements."
  - Transfer: the warranty runs "to the original purchaser of the home and to all subsequent owners of the home who take title during the applicable warranty coverage periods."
  - Dispute resolution: the book contains a "binding arbitration procedure" in its "Resolving Disputes" section.
  - Scope limit stated on the warranty page: "The warranty description set forth above does not describe or apply to homes in California or New Jersey." [source: https://www.pulte.com/build/10-year-warranty | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **in_house_lender:** Pulte Mortgage LLC, NMLS 1791 [source: https://www.pulte.com/homes/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - **Are incentives conditioned on using it? Yes.** Verbatim from the offer disclaimer on Pulte's Las Vegas page: "Example based on new contracts and participation in the Affiliate Incentive Program, including financing through Pulte Mortgage LLC (NMLS 1791), and application of all incentives toward closing costs, including any discount points, including the cost of the temporary buydown fee of $20,125, based on a FHA 30 year fixed mortgage, sales price $500,000, loan amount $490,943 (includes upfront mortgage insurance premium) with a 3.5% down payment and interest rate of 4.99%/5.781% APR effective 7/15/26." [source: https://www.pulte.com/homes/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - The same disclaimer spells out the buydown steps: "bought down year 1 to $1,812 based on an effective rate of 1.99%, year 2 to $2,067 based on an effective rate of 2.99, year 3 to $2,341 based on an effective rate of 3.99% and years 4-30 the payments revert to the f[ull rate]" [source: https://www.pulte.com/homes/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Worth putting in the guide plainly: on this structure the temporary buydown is a real, quantified cost ($20,125 on a $500,000 home) that is paid out of the incentive pool.

- **upgrade_policy:** Design Centers, branded the Home Expressions Studio for to-be-built homes. Verbatim: "After you've picked your home, you can explore a refined selection of sought-after features and finishes. Our Design Centers are located across the country and have all the options you need." [source: https://www.pulte.com/design/design-center | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Pulte also publishes four interactive pre-visit tools: Interactive Floor Plan Tool, Elevation Tool, Furniture Planner Tool, and Design Studio Tool [source: https://www.pulte.com/design/design-center | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Published design-center spend requirement or credit: NOT FOUND
  - Whether upgrades can be financed: NOT FOUND

- **build_timeline:** NOT FOUND. Pulte publishes no contract-to-close time for Las Vegas.
  - Pulte does sell quick move-in inventory. Its Las Vegas page carries a "Quick Move-Ins" tab alongside "Communities" [source: https://www.pulte.com/homes/nevada/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **price_band:** Starting prices ran from $375,990 (Dalea at Aries, Henderson townhomes) to $960,990 (Daylight, Las Vegas single family). Three communities showed no price ("Price Not Listed" or "Price Coming Soon"). Product is single family plus two townhome communities [source: https://www.pulte.com/api/Community/ProductCommunitySearch?brand=Pulte&state=Nevada&region=Las%20Vegas&pageSize=50&pageNumber=0 | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Pricing date: 2026-07-25.

## 4. KB Home

- **builder:** KB Home [source: https://www.kbhome.com/new-homes-las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **warranty:** KB Home publishes the structure on a dated article page, updated 6/9/2026. Verbatim: "Most homes include one year of coverage for workmanship and materials, two years for major systems like plumbing, electrical, and HVAC, and 10 years for structural components such as the foundation and framing." [source: https://www.kbhome.com/what-is-the-kb-home-10-year-limited-warranty | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Structural scope, verbatim: "Should you have warranty issues with the foundation, roof framing systems, framing, or other structural elements, we've got you covered."
  - Transfer, verbatim: "Your warranty coverage also transfers to any subsequent buyer should you sell your KB home within 10 years."
  - State variation, verbatim: "While warranties can vary slightly from state to state, every KB homebuyer has the benefit of a comprehensive agreement and dedicated warranty team." KB does not publish a Nevada-specific addendum, so the Nevada terms are NOT FOUND at the state level.
  - Follow-up program, verbatim: KB "incorporates a unique process of pre-set warranty follow-ups, including maintenance responsibilities of homeowners, so you can look forward to hearing from us at key times throughout your 1-year warranty period, and up to 18 months after you've moved in." (Quoted with the original dash replaced by a comma per this file's style rule.)
  - All quotes [source: https://www.kbhome.com/what-is-the-kb-home-10-year-limited-warranty | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **in_house_lender:** KBHS Home Loans, LLC, NMLS 1542802, 300 East Royal Lane, Suite 250, Irving, TX 75039, 855-378-6625 [source: https://www.kbhome.com/new-homes-las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Affiliate disclosure, verbatim and present on every KB Home page footer: "KB Home and KBHS share common ownership and because of this relationship may receive a financial or other benefit. You are not required to use KBHS as a condition of purchase or sale of any real estate." [source: https://www.kbhome.com/new-homes-las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - **Are incentives conditioned on using it? NOT FOUND.** KB Home's site-wide banner advertises "Below Market Rates + Transparent Pricing = Buying with Confidence" and links to a rates page, but no published disclaimer tying rate or incentive eligibility to KBHS was located on the Las Vegas market page, the warranty page, the design studio page, or the build-process page [source: https://www.kbhome.com/new-homes-las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]. Treat this as an open verification item, not as a claim that no condition exists.

- **upgrade_policy:** KB Home Design Studio. The Las Vegas studio is at 5795 Badura Ave. #150, Las Vegas, NV 89118. ## 5. Richmond American Homes (M.D.C. / Sekisui House)

- **builder:** Richmond American Homes. Ownership matters here and is stated by the company itself, verbatim: "The Richmond American Homes companies (RAH), HomeAmerican Mortgage Corporation (HMC), American Home Insurance Agency, Inc. (also known as AHI Insurance Agency or AHI) and American Home Title and Escrow Company (AHT) are owned, directly or indirectly, by Sekisui House U.S., Inc. and, therefore, are affiliated companies." [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/nevada/las-vegas-new-homes/henderson/cresta-rosa/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **warranty:** 1 year, 2 year, 10 year. Verbatim from a Richmond American published guide: "Richmond American homes come with a limited warranty with the following coverages: 1-year limited warranty on stated materials and workmanship; 2-year limited warranty on stated systems; 10-year limited warranty on major structural items. Visit a Sales Center for details on terms, conditions and limitations of the limited warranty or to view the documentation." [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/content/globalmedia/guides/ntl0515170_sellingnewhomes_guide_update_interactive.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - **Staleness flag the guide must respect:** that PDF's own copyright line reads 2015 and its filename encodes 2017. It is hosted live on richmondamerican.com today but it is not a current dated publication. The live warranty page at `https://www.richmondamerican.com/warranty/` publishes only a service request form and contains no term lengths at all [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/warranty/ | verified: 2026-07-25]. Current Nevada term lengths: **NOT FOUND** from a dated 2026 source. Present these as "as published by the builder" and tell readers to get the warranty document before signing.
  - Companion footnote, verbatim: "Warranties are limited and subject to terms, conditions and limitations. Visit a Sales Center for details on the limited warranty provided in connection with the purchase of a Richmond American home." [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/content/globalmedia/guides/ntl0515170_sellingnewhomes_guide_update_interactive.pdf | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **in_house_lender:** HomeAmerican Mortgage Corporation (HMC), an affiliate under Sekisui House U.S., Inc. [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/nevada/las-vegas-new-homes/henderson/cresta-rosa/ | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Affiliate disclosure, verbatim: "Each of RAH, HMC, AHI and AHT offers services independently of each other, and if you obtain a product or service from one company, you are not required to utilize the services of, or obtain products from, any of the other companies. Your decision to use a company that is not affiliated with RAH, HMC, AHI or AHT will not affect your ability to obtain products and services from these companies." [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/nevada/las-vegas-new-homes/henderson/cresta-rosa/ | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - **Are incentives conditioned on using it? NOT FOUND.** No published Las Vegas incentive-conditioning language was located on Richmond American's own market page or community pages. Note the tension worth flagging: the affiliate disclosure says a decision not to use HMC "will not affect your ability to obtain products and services", which is a statement about availability of services, not a statement about incentive eligibility. Verify at the sales center.

- **upgrade_policy:** Home Gallery design centers. Richmond American describes them as "boutique-style showrooms" that "offer a dazzling array of personalization options for clients that build their home from the ground up, along with complimentary one-on-one assistance from a design professional" [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/agent-blog/home-gallery-personalization-options/ | verified: 2026-07-25]

  - Whether upgrades can be financed: NOT FOUND

- **build_timeline:** NOT FOUND. Richmond American publishes no contract-to-close time for Las Vegas. Its community pages do say, verbatim: "Closing dates are subject to change and cannot be guaranteed." [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/nevada/las-vegas-new-homes/henderson/cresta-rosa/ | verified: 2026-07-25]
  - Richmond American sells heavily from finished inventory. Its Las Vegas market page counted "115 new homes in Las Vegas area", most tagged "Ready for move-in now" [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/nevada/las-vegas-new-homes | verified: 2026-07-25]

- **price_band:** Community-level "from" prices are **NOT FOUND** on Richmond American's Las Vegas market page; the page prices individual homes, not communities. Actual listed home prices on the verification date ran from $514,950 (Eldorado Springs, 2,010 sq ft, Las Vegas) to $1,547,950 (Salerno Summit at SouthShore Lake Las Vegas, 3,680 sq ft, Henderson) [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/nevada/las-vegas-new-homes | verified: 2026-07-25]

Richmond American's own listing labels it "Eldorado Valley in Las Vegas, NV / Clark county" [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/nevada/las-vegas-new-homes | verified: 2026-07-25]. It is kept in scope on that basis. Its sitemap path also files it under `/nevada/las-vegas-new-homes/las-vegas/`, not under Boulder City.

  **Name-collision resolution.** The internal corpus flagged Windsor Heights and Solstice as claimed by two builders. Both names are real and both builders are real: Richmond American has "Windsor Heights" and "Solstice at Sunstone" [source: https://www.richmondamerican.com/sitemap.xml | verified: 2026-07-25], and Taylor Morrison independently has "Windsor Heights" and "Solstice" [source: https://www.taylormorrison.com/nv/las-vegas | verified: 2026-07-25]. The guide must disambiguate by builder or it will mislead readers.

# Cross-builder summary for the comparison table

**In-house lender and whether published incentives are conditioned on it**

| Builder | Affiliated lender | Incentive conditioned on using it? |

# Coverage of the seven required guide areas

Based only on the community lists verified above.

- **Summerlin:** covered by Lennar, KB Home, Richmond American, Taylor Morrison, Tri Pointe, Woodside, Pulte (Brantley).
- **Henderson (including Cadence, Inspirada, Lake Las Vegas):** covered by every builder except Meritage and LGI.
- **North Las Vegas (including Tule Springs):** covered by Lennar, KB Home, D.R. Horton, Richmond American, Century Communities.
- **Skye Canyon:** covered by Century Communities (four Skyeview communities) and LGI (Topaz at Skye Canyon).
- **Mountain's Edge:** covered by Richmond American (Archer Park at Mountain's Edge). **No other builder in this set names Mountain's Edge on its own site.** The internal corpus's Lexington Chase report described six active Mountain's Edge builders; only Richmond American's own naming is verified here, and Richmond American's Lexington Chase is filed simply as Las Vegas.
- **Sunrise Manor:** covered by LGI Homes only (Hollywood Springs, The Oasis at Hollywood Springs).
- **Centennial Hills:** **NOT FOUND.** No builder in this set of twelve names Centennial Hills on its own Las Vegas pages. This confirms the internal finding that Centennial Hills has zero coverage and must be researched from scratch, likely by ZIP code (89149, 89131, 89143, 89166) rather than by community name. Woodside's Homestead-adjacent Las Vegas 89149 communities and Century's Homestead West (89149) are the closest verified signals.
- **Union Village:** **zero verified active communities.** See the Century Communities section.

# Open verification items for downstream agents

These are gaps, not facts. None of them may be filled with an assumption.

1. **Beazer's full Clark County community count.** The "Load more" control on `beazer.com/las-vegas-nv` did not advance during verification. Ten communities are confirmed; the true total may be higher.
2. **Century Communities' fourteenth Las Vegas community.** Century's page says 14 results; 13 were surfaced.
3. **Century Communities, Taylor Morrison, and Woodside warranty terms.** None publish term lengths. If the guide's table needs these, they must come from a purchase agreement or a sales office, and should be attributed that way.
4. **LGI Homes' structural warranty term.** LGI names a structural warranty without a term.
5. **Tri Pointe's Nevada warranty terms.** The 2-10 booklet puts the terms on the buyer's Certificate of Warranty Coverage, not in the public document.
6. **Whether KB Home, Richmond American, Woodside, and Tri Pointe condition incentives on their affiliated lenders.** All four have affiliated lenders; none publish conditioning language on their Las Vegas pages.
7. **Richmond American community-level starting prices.** Their market page prices homes, not communities.
8. **Richmond American's current warranty document.** The only published term lengths sit in a PDF whose own copyright line reads 2015.
9. **Build timelines for eleven of twelve builders.** KB Home is the only one that publishes a number. If the guide states a range for the market, it must be sourced to something other than these builders' websites, or clearly labeled as Ryan's own observation rather than a builder claim.
10. **Whether upgrades can be financed, for every builder.** Not one of the twelve publishes an answer.
11. **Design-center spend requirements or credits, for every builder.** Not one of the twelve publishes a figure.
12. **Tri Pointe's "Available Promotions (1)" terms**, which did not render.
13. **Woodside's "flexible savings" offer terms**, which did not render.
14. **Centennial Hills coverage**, which is absent from all twelve builder sites and needs a ZIP-based search.
